notes.title: Elites
notes.content:
This patch adds elite variants of many enemies to the game. Elites are bigger, tankier, faster, deadlier, and in some cases smarter than their basic versions, and have a much higher chance to drop rewards. Additionally, when an elite enemy would drop a normal component, it instead drops something stronger.

You can identify elites by a red tinge outline, a red trail, and also the fact that they are probably chasing you more aggressively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/c106fcbe1d7c338af5597156797ac596f5cd8235.png[/img]

This patch reworks Pierce, which is now Chain. Chain has significantly more projectile redirect after hitting an enemy, and also now works for Pulse.

Finally, a few enemies later in the game have had their health pools reduced slightly, and the Consumer boss has had its speed and collision damage reduced slightly as well.

notes.title: New Enemies, New Systems
notes.content:
This patch adds 4 new enemies with new systems to the game.

One of the new systems is Spray:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/7ef5ab143e3782a2529c3bf33d053eab139a01ed.png[/img]

If you want to fire many more projectiles, and aren't particular about where those projectiles end up, Spray lets you increase both your fire speed and volley speed, which can help you deal damage much much faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/c0a970b4dc99fd85f581f9089b70f1e7b6863657.gif[/img]

This patch also adds rerolling to the shop. If you don't like the shop's current offers, you can spend another key to reroll, which will never pick the same systems it just had.

This patch also reduces the damage and fire rate of some enemies, particularly some bosses, and reduces the Titan's health by 10%, to smooth out game progression a bit.

If you bought the game and you're enjoying it, please consider leaving a review, and if you have feedback, please feel free to add it in the Steam Discussions.

notes.title: The Boring Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/b0446aa24b24b959350c4aca33b250d28a9160da.png[/img]

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
This update adds controller support to the game, including navigating menus and building your ship.

This update also includes a fix for keybinds, where after you set your keybinds I was forgetting to save what you set them as.

Please let me know if any of the controller specific changes don't work, or if any of them could be better. Finally, thank you for playing my game!

notes.title: Updates for both demo and full game
notes.content:
This patch includes a few changes to the game, as well as bringing the demo up to the current version.

Full game:
[list]
[*]Corrected tooltip for Collision Damage System, which was showing the wrong value for damage it granted.
[*]Small reduction in turning speed for Juggernauts to make them easier to avoid.
[/list]
Demo:
[list]
[*]Reorganized settings and added two new settings, half damage taken and half speed. Half damage taken reduces all damage the player takes by half, and half speed reduces the rate that the game runs at by half. Hopefully these settings make the game dramatically more playable for some players.
[*]Buffed Pulse damage by 2 and Pulse rate dramatically. Pulse will consume more energy due to this.
[*]Many systems, such as Weapons, now show in their tooltip how much they increase or decrease by a percent.
[*]Barrier now recovers 10% of total barrier on trigger, rather than a flat 2 points.
[*]Hull now decreases damage to Hull points by 3, up from 2.
[/list]
